metrics.name: Active Account Count
metrics.gotcha: Accounts[].IsActive is BOOLEAN (true/false). Account fields include: Id, AccountName, AccountType, BusinessType, ServiceType, AccountManager, IsActive, IsBilling, CreditLimit, TenantName.

metrics.name: Total Contract Count
metrics.gotcha: Contracts[].Status is a STRING (e.g. 'New'). Contracts[].EndDate is ISO datetime string (e.g. '2022-09-08T00:00:00'). Fields include: Id, ContractName, AccountName, Type, SLA, Status, ContractHours, StartDate, EndDate, BillingCycle, ContractBillingPrice.

metrics.name: Total Role Count
metrics.gotcha: Roles[].fields include: Id, Name, Description, IsActive, BillingRate.

metrics.name: Active User Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[].IsActive is BOOLEAN (true/false). Use backtick-quoted boolean literal. Different from some other PSA inspectors where active flag is an integer.
